article.title: War on Yemen exposes deepening Saudi-Israeli military coordination
article.author: Editor
article.content: A ScheerPost analysis argues that Saudi Arabia and “Israel” are deepening covert military cooperation against the Yemeni Armed Forces through intelligence sharing, private contacts, and sectarian messaging. The post War on Yemen exposes deepening Saudi-Israeli military coordination appeared first on MR Online .
